name: ColorSwatch
summary: Displays a single-colour or two-tone colour preview.

useWhen: Showing a color, or a two-tone pair such as a theme, as a preview
avoidWhen: Choosing from preset colors; use ColorSwatchPicker

obligations: Render the supplied Core color string without exposing upstream color types.
Two-tone previews describe both colours, with an optional localized colorName override.

behavior: Valid Core color strings are converted internally for rendering.
secondaryColor adds a diagonal two-tone preview; both colours retain their alpha without painting one over the other.
shape defaults to square with the existing token radius; circle uses a circular outline.
colorName optionally names the preview in the application locale; otherwise two-tone previews combine localized descriptions of both colours. Native DOM and ARIA props and the div ref are preserved.
accessibility: Render the supplied Core color string without exposing upstream color types.
Two-tone previews describe both colours, with an optional localized colorName override.
